assertions.name: difference_links_reducible_nonhyperbolic
assertions.source: Regina isIrreducible=False (essential spheres ⇒ split ⇒ non-hyperbolic) and/or unstable/negative SnapPy volume — the difference-knot 'volume' of PR #2235/#2242 is an artifact

description: RETRACTION of PR #2235/#2242: the binding difference link D = W_atom·W_free⁻¹ is reducible (Regina isIrreducible=False) and non-hyperbolic — SnapPy's volume is unstable (cv 29-132%) and frequently negative, i.e. noise on a non-geometric triangulation. The 'nonzero A-growing volumes' previously reported are artifacts. Converges with binding_volume_difference_probe.py (derived braid closures non-hyperbolic). prop:binding-error-amplification stands; only the difference-knot-volume realisation is refuted.

data.retraction: PR #2235/#2242 reported hyperbolic volumes for the difference link; they are SnapPy noise on non-geometric triangulations. The links are reducible (split) and non-hyperbolic. The geometric binding route must use the hand-assigned hyperbolic census knots (conj:canonical-knot-id-sdp), not a volume of the raw difference braid. prop:binding-error-amplification is unaffected.
